chunks: And by this chain of narrators, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: 'Say: No reward do I ask of you for this nor am I a pretender. It is nothing but a reminder to the nations.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him).' 'And most certainly you will come to know about it after a time.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'At the emergence of Al-Qa'im (peace be upon him).'

And regarding the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: 'We certainly gave the Book to Moses, but differences arose therein.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'They differed just as this community has differed regarding the Book, and they will differ regarding the Book which is with Al-Qa'im, which he will bring to them, to the extent that many people will deny it. So he will march against them and strike their necks.'

And as for His Statement, the Mighty and Majestic: 'And but for a decisive word it would have been judged between them. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful Punishment.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Had it not been for what had preceded among them from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, Al-Qa'im (peace be upon him) would not have left any one of them alive.'

And regarding the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: 'And those who accept the truth of the Judgement day,' He (peace be upon him) said: 'The emergence of Al-Qa'im (peace be upon him).' And His Statement, the Mighty and Majestic: 'By Allah, our Lord, we were not polytheists,' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It means the Wilayah of Ali (peace be upon him).'

And regarding the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: 'And say: The truth has come and the falsehood has vanished,' He (peace be upon him) said: 'When Al-Qa'im (peace be upon him) makes his stand, the dominion of falsehood will be destroyed.'
ai.seo_question: How do Shia scholars interpret Quranic verses regarding the emergence of Al-Qa'im and the victory of truth?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi presents a concise eschatological exegesis where Imam al-Baqir links key Quranic phrases to the authority of Imam Ali and the eventual rise of Al-Qa'im. It highlights the theme of divine patience, explaining that the 'decisive word' refers to the period before Al-Qa'im's emergence, during which he delays executing those who deny his leadership despite their oppression. The narration culminates in the triumph of truth over falsehood, framing Al-Qa'im's appearance as the definitive vanquishing of illegitimate political powers.

en.hubeali: H 14880 – And by the above chain (of narrators), who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’farasws

regarding the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[38:86] Say: “No reward do I ask of you for this nor am I a pretender [38:87] It is nothing but a reminder to the nations”. Heasws said: ‘It (the Reminder) is Amir-ul- Momineenasws’. “[38:88] And most certainly you will come to know about it after a time”. Heasws said: ‘During the coming out of Al-Qaimasws’.

And with regards to the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic “[11:110] We certainly gave the Book to Moses, but differences arose therein”. Heasws said: ‘They differed just like this community has differed regarding the Book, and they will be differing with regards to the Book with Al-Qaimasws which heasws will be coming to them with, to the extent that numerous people would deny it. So heasws will march against them and strike their necks.

And as for the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[42:21] And but for a decisive word it would have been judged between them. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful Punishment”. Had it not been for what had preceded among them from Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, Al-Qaimasws would not let remain any one among them’.

And with regards to the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[70:26] And those who accept the truth of the Judgement day”, heasws said: ‘The coming out of Al-Qaimasws’. And the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[6:23] By Allah, our Lord, we were not polytheists”, heasws said: ‘It means the Wilayah of Aliasws ‘.

And with regards to the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[17:81] And say: The truth has come and the falsehood has vanished; surely falsehood is a vanishing (thing)”, heasws said: ‘When Al-Qaimasws makes the stand the governments of the falsehood will be destroyed’.
en.sarwar: 433. From him, from Ali Bin Al-Hassan, from Mansour bin Yunus, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following:

I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s.) about: “[16:98] So when you recite the Quran, seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Shaitan [16:99] Surely he has no authority over those who believe and rely on their Lord”, so he (a.s.) said; ‘O Abu Muhammad! By Allah (azwj), he (la) overcomes the Believer upon his body but does not overcome his Religion. He (la) had overcome upon Ayub (as), so he (la) deformed his (as) physique and did not overcome upon his (as) Religion, and he (la) has overcome the Believers upon their bodies and does not overcome upon their Religion’.
I said, ‘The Statement of the High: “[16:100] His authority is only over those who befriend him and those who associate others with Him.”
He (a.s.) said: ‘The ones who associate with Allah (azwj), he (la) overcomes upon their bodies as well as upon their Religions’.
